questions.prompt: What goes on before any tool comes out?
questions.reason: Safety glasses protect your eyes from chips and dust.

questions.prompt: What is the very first shop rule?
choices: Ask a grown-up before you start
questions.reason: A grown-up always knows what you are doing first.
Small grit numbers are rough; big numbers are smooth.

questions.prompt: On a tape measure, the longest little line between two inches is…
questions.reason: The half-inch line is the longest one between the inch marks.

questions.prompt: A hand saw cuts mostly when you…
questions.reason: Most western hand saws cut on the push stroke.

questions.prompt: You get a small cut. What do you do first?
questions.reason: Always tell a grown-up, even about small cuts.

questions.prompt: How do you keep your fingers safe when starting a nail?
choices: Use your thumb as a guide
questions.reason: A clothespin holds the nail so your fingers stay back.
Sanding along the grain leaves no scratches you can see.
